components.name: Browser Initialization
components.details: Initializes CoreWebView2Environment with userDataFolder and navigates to target TikTok livestream URL (Desktop or Mobile).

components.name: Script Fetch & Verification
components.details: HTTP GET from jqsvn.com endpoint. Validates Content-Type, max length 1MB, checks for error/denied tokens, verifies presence of communicate_launcher and TikeqID, computes SHA-256.

components.name: DOM Bootstrap Injection
components.details: Executes JS IIFE checking location.href and window.__ggttEmbeddedCode state; sets state="ready" and assigns unique session token.

components.name: Script Payload Execution
components.details: Checks __ggttEmbeddedCode.state==="ready" and token matching. Transitions to "executing", evaluates remote script body, transitions to "installed", returns {ggttEmbeddedReady: token}.

components.name: Injection Acknowledgment
components.details: Parses JSON return from WebView2, verifies ggttEmbeddedReady matches document token.

components.name: WebMessage Dispatcher
components.details: Extracts WebMessageAsString, parses event type, dispatches gifts to TeamScoringService.Gift or TeamChannelPkService.Record.
